name: Waterfall Emails
description: Find + verify email waterfall: MV on existing, then Trykitt + LeadMagic finders, MillionVerifier gates each tier, catch-alls resolve via BounceBan Poller. Writes Final Email/Source/Status back and logs the run to the Hub run-log.

parameters.formDescription: Find + verify emails. Catch-alls resolve in the background via the BounceBan Poller.

values.placeholder: People (required; Companies is refused, use Verify Emails)

parameters.jsCode: @@file:nodes/Resolve-Table.js
@@file:nodes/Email-Guard.js
@@file:nodes/Verdict.js
@@file:nodes/To-Airtable.js
@@file:nodes/Build-Log.js
@@file:nodes/Collect-Pending.js
@@file:nodes/Fix-Client.js
@@file:nodes/Launch-Params.js

nodes.name: Prospeo Find
nodes.notes: P3 tier. Attach the "Prospeo" Header Auth credential manually: the n8n API cannot set credentials on httpRequest nodes.

nodes.name: MV P3
nodes.notes: MillionVerifier gate for the Prospeo tier. Uses the same MillionVerifier query-auth credential as MV P0 / MV P1 / MV P2; attach it manually.

nodes.name: Pack Rows

parameters.jsCode: @@file:nodes/Pack-Rows.js

nodes.notes: Carries parent-run context into each batch item so the sub-execution can resolve base, table, client, run id and start time without reaching back to Params / Email Guard / Resolve Client.

nodes.name: Batch
nodes.notes: 100 rows per sub-execution. Keeps every $('Read Records').item lookup resolving against 100 items instead of the whole table.

nodes.name: Run Batch
nodes.notes: Calls this same workflow. Entry point on the other side is Batch Trigger, which never reaches Fetch Rows, so there is no recursion.

nodes.name: Read Records
nodes.notes: Deliberately named Read Records so every existing $('Read Records').item expression in the finder and Verdict nodes keeps resolving, now against one batch.

nodes.name: Read Log Row
nodes.notes: Durable accumulator. Static data written inside a sub-execution is not persisted back, so each batch reads the run's Hub row, adds its slice, and writes it again. Batches are sequential, so no race.

nodes.name: Batch Tick

parameters.jsCode: @@file:nodes/Batch-Tick.js

nodes.notes: Always emits exactly one item so the Split In Batches loop advances regardless of what the sub-execution returned. The sub's last node is Collect Pending, which is empty whenever a batch sends nobody to BounceBan; feeding that straight back stopped the loop after one batch.

parameters.jsCode: @@file:nodes/Check-Columns.js

parameters.jsCode:
// The loop must never depend on the sub-execution's output shape.
return [{ json: { tick: true } }];

nodes.notes: Always emits exactly one item so the Split In Batches loop advances regardless of what the sub-execution returned. The sub's last node is Collect Pending, which is empty whenever a batch sends nobody to BounceBan; feeding that straight back stopped the loop after one batch.
